title: 873. Reachable Nodes In Subdivided Graph

examples.explanation: All 3 original nodes are within reach. The three links contribute 7, 1 and 2 reachable middle nodes, for 3 + 7 + 1 + 2 = 13.
All 4 original nodes are within reach, and the four links contribute 4, 6, 8 and 1 middle nodes, for 4 + 4 + 6 + 8 + 1 = 23.
Node 0 is isolated, so with no way to leave it only node 0 itself is reachable.
